Name: (DGA) Pokemon Furniture
Author: oddandevander
Description:
[b][i]MUST DOWNLOAD [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9365]Dynamic Game Assets[/url]﻿ (+its required mods) FOR THIS MOD TO WORK![/i][/b]

This mod adds 637 Pokemon sprites, including shinies, into the game as custom furniture, without replacing anything. These sprites can be obtained by Robin or the furniture catalogue.

[u]How to Obtain
[/u][list]
[*]To obtain Pokemon furniture, you can purchase them from [b]Robin[/b] (all currently 100g)
[*]You can also get them from the [b]Furniture Catalogue[/b] (last category)
[*]Typing "[b]dga_store[/b]" into the SMAPI console after loading up your game will bring up all options (no cost)
[/list]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/1638]FULL LIST OF INCLUDED POKEMON HERE[/url] 

[b][center]=== [u]KNOWN ISSUES / MODDER INFO[/u] ===[/center]
Anyone intested in helping, improving this mod, or using it for another mod can feel free to reach out if you need anything! (E.g. Pokemon sprites for all facing directions)

[/b][b]ISSUE 1: [/b]The list of Pokemon furniture is so long that the scroll bar on the right (blue rectangle in my screenshots) won't visibly move on screen when you scroll, probably because of the quantity.
[list]
[*][b]Possible solutions:[/b]
[*]Adding a new store for only Pokemon furniture so they can be divided into categories. I'm not sure how to do this myself yet.
[*]Adding new ways to obtain Pokemon apart from stores, still not sure how to do this myself.
[/list]
